zh-CN.title: 群聊提及更清晰
items: 群聊消息中的 @成员 现在会明确高亮
发送中的消息与正式消息保持相同效果
链接、邮箱和普通 @文字不会被误标记

en.title: Clearer group mentions
items: Mentioned members are now highlighted in group messages
Pending and delivered messages share the same mention styling
Links, emails, and ordinary @ text are not highlighted by mistake
